response.overview: [A controversial story about the abduction and rape of two girls is brought to life in this film] A middle-aged man repeatedly uses obscene language on a local train line and begins to molest a female student. His actions escalate, and he brutally rapes the frightened girl at an unmanned station. Another man who witnesses the scene becomes aroused and becomes a copycat. He ambushes the female student and brutally rapes her. The rapes at the unmanned station do not stop, and the two rapists conspire to confine the female student in the station building. A heinous blackmail rape case that defiles both the body and mind of the two girls.
